name: Gravity Lens
description: A dark disk grows, bending the first clip around it like a heavy mass bends light, swallows the frame, then shrinks back, unbending the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Center of the disk (0..1, y down)

params.name: hole
params.description: Color of the disk (the original is black; a near black keeps it from reading as an empty frame)
